title: Effective Biological Representation Learning by Masking Gene Expression
abstract: arXiv:2605.31562v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: RNA sequencing produces rich and diverse datasets of gene expression, offering compelling insights into cellular state and function that have many applications in drug discovery. Modeling such data is challenging due to inherent technical noise and experimental batch effects, as evidenced by many existing transcriptomic foundation models (FMs) underperforming relative to linear baselines. Such results raise the question of whether deep representation learning provides a distinct advantage over the direct use of raw transcript counts. Our work explores this by developing a new self-supervised model, TxFM, with a focus on inductive representation learning evaluations. TxFM employs a masked autoencoding approach tailored to diverse RNA-seq count data, and our ablation study empirically identifies crucial architecture configurations required for strong transfer performance. Additionally, we curate a public training corpus, DiverseRNA-1.4

translated_title: 通过掩码基因表达实现有效的生物表征学习
translated_abstract: RNA测序产生了丰富多样的基因表达数据集，为了解细胞状态和功能提供了极具价值的洞见，在药物发现中有着广泛的应用。由于固有的技术噪声和实验批次效应，对这类数据进行建模极具挑战性，许多现有的转录组基础模型（FMs）表现不及线性基线便印证了这一点。这些结果引发了一个问题：深度表征学习相比直接使用原始转录本计数是否具有独特优势。我们的工作通过开发一个新的自监督模型TxFM来探索这一问题，重点关注归纳式表征学习评估。TxFM采用了一种针对多样化RNA-seq计数数据量身定制的掩码自编码方法，我们的消融研究通过实验确定了实现强迁移性能所需的关键架构配置。此外，我们构建了一个公开的训练语料库DiverseRNA-1.4
tldr: 该论文提出了针对多样化RNA-seq计数数据量身定制的掩码自编码自监督模型TxFM，并通过消融研究确定了关键架构配置，显著提升了转录组数据的归纳式表征学习与迁移性能。
en_tdlr: TxFM, a self-supervised masked autoencoding model tailored to diverse RNA-seq count data, achieves strong inductive transferable representations, addressing why many transcriptomic foundation models underperform linear baselines.
